name: MITRE Explorer
description: Threat intelligence agent for MITRE ATT&CK, ATLAS, CVE vulnerabilities, and application security. Query techniques, threat groups, campaigns, software, CVEs (with EPSS exploit-probability scoring), CAPEC attack patterns, detection strategies, and compliance mappings across Enterprise, ICS, Mobile, and ATLAS domains.

skills.name: CVE Vulnerability Lookup
skills.description: Search and retrieve CVE vulnerability details including CVSS scores, severity, CWEs, EPSS exploit-probability scores (First.org, daily refreshed), CAPEC attack patterns, affected applications, linked ATT&CK techniques, and CISA KEV status. Covers 21,000+ CVEs from 2017-2026.
examples: What is CVE-2024-3400?
Show me critical CVEs affecting Apache HTTP Server
What new CVEs were published in the last 7 days?
Which CVEs are linked to technique T1190?
What is the EPSS score for CVE-2021-44228?
Which CAPEC attack patterns apply to CVE-2024-3400?

skills.name: ATT&CK Technique Intelligence
skills.description: Get detailed intelligence on ATT&CK and ATLAS techniques: threat groups using them, Sigma detection rules, Atomic Red Team tests, D3FEND countermeasures, affected applications, NIST 800-53 control mappings, and CAPEC attack patterns mapped to the technique.
examples: What groups use T1059 Command and Scripting Interpreter?
Give me Sigma rules for T1566 Phishing
What are the D3FEND countermeasures for T1190?
Show me ATLAS technique AML.T0051
Which CAPEC attack patterns map to T1190?

skills.name: Threat Group Profile
skills.description: Retrieve threat actor group profiles with their techniques, targeted sectors, software used, campaigns, and targeted applications. Covers 191 ATT&CK groups plus 514 ETDA/ThaiCERT external actors.
examples: What techniques does APT29 use?
Which groups target the financial sector?
Show me the profile of Lazarus Group
Compare APT28 and APT29 techniques

skills.name: Application Vulnerability Assessment
skills.description: Check the security posture of 11,000+ vendor products. Returns CVEs, CWE weakness profile, reachable ATT&CK techniques, and associated threat groups via the CVE-CWE-CAPEC-ATT&CK chain.
examples: What CVEs affect LiteLLM?
Show the attack surface for Microsoft Windows Server 2022
Which threat groups target Apache Tomcat?
What are the top 10 most vulnerable applications?

skills.name: Sector Threat Landscape
skills.description: Analyze threats to industry sectors: groups targeting the sector, their techniques, campaigns, vulnerable applications, and associated CVEs. Covers 12 sectors including Financial, Healthcare, Government, Energy, Telecom.
examples: What groups target the healthcare sector?
Show the threat landscape for financial services
Which techniques are most used against energy sector?

skills.name: Detection & Compliance Search
skills.description: Search Sigma rules (3,100+), Atomic Red Team tests (1,770+), D3FEND countermeasures (5,000+), NIST 800-53 controls (5,200+), MITRE Engage mappings, VERIS mappings, and cloud security controls for Azure and GCP.
examples: What Sigma rules detect credential dumping?
Show NIST controls for T1078 Valid Accounts
What Atomic tests exist for T1059?
List Azure cloud controls for T1190

skills.name: Threat Intelligence Reports
skills.description: Access recent CTI reports from AlienVault OTX, DFIR Report, Unit42, Microsoft Security, and Talos. Reports are mapped to ATT&CK techniques with IOC indicators.
examples: Show me the latest threat reports
What reports mention T1059?
Any recent reports about ransomware?

skills.name: Cross-Domain Entity Search
skills.description: Search across all entity types (techniques, groups, software, campaigns, mitigations, data sources, applications) in all domains (Enterprise, ICS, Mobile, ATLAS).
examples: Search for phishing
Find all entities related to Mimikatz
What entities match 'remote code execution'?

skills.name: Malware & Tool Analysis
skills.description: Search and profile 914 malware families and attacker tools. Get techniques, groups using them, campaigns, and platform coverage.
examples: What techniques does Cobalt Strike use?
Search for ransomware tools
Which groups use Mimikatz?

skills.name: Campaign Intelligence
skills.description: Search and analyze 56 named campaigns with timelines, techniques, software, and threat groups involved.
examples: What was Operation ShadowHammer?
Show campaigns targeting the financial sector
List recent campaigns by APT29

skills.name: Mitigation Guidance
skills.description: Search 369 mitigations and get specific countermeasure guidance for ATT&CK techniques.
examples: How do I mitigate T1059 Command and Scripting?
What mitigations exist for credential theft?
Show me network-based mitigations

skills.name: IOC Feed Search
skills.description: Search 5,800+ IOCs (IPs, domains, hashes, URLs, CVEs) with VirusTotal verdicts and malware family attribution. Sources: OTX, ThreatFox, MalwareBazaar, CISA KEV.
examples: Show me IOCs from the last 24 hours
Search for Emotet IOCs
What malicious hashes were reported today?

skills.name: Sigma Detection Rules
skills.description: Search 3,100+ Sigma rules by keyword, technique, or severity. Get YAML rule details for SIEM deployment.
examples: Sigma rules for credential dumping
Show critical Sigma rules for T1059
Find Sigma rules for PowerShell abuse

skills.name: Atomic Red Team Tests
skills.description: Search 1,770+ Atomic Red Team tests for adversary emulation. Filter by technique, platform, and executor type.
examples: Atomic tests for T1059 on Windows
Show me Linux persistence tests
What tests exist for lateral movement?

skills.name: External Threat Actor Profiles
skills.description: Search 514 threat actors from ETDA/ThaiCERT with country attribution, state sponsors, motivation, suspected victims, and MITRE ATT&CK group mappings.
examples: Show me Russian state-sponsored actors
What is known about Lazarus Group?
List actors targeting critical infrastructure

skills.name: OWASP Top 10 Analysis
skills.description: Get OWASP Top 10 categories for Web (2021), ML (2023), and LLM (2025) security risks mapped to ATT&CK + ATLAS techniques via CWE.
examples: Show me the OWASP Top 10 categories
What techniques relate to OWASP A01 Broken Access Control?
Which CVEs are linked to OWASP Injection (A03)?
Map OWASP A07 Authentication Failures to ATT&CK
Show me the ML Top 10 AI security risks
Which ATLAS techniques map to LLM01 Prompt Injection?
Compare Web and LLM OWASP supply chain risks

skills.name: GitHub Security Advisory Detail
skills.description: Get full details for a GitHub Security Advisory: summary, description, CVSS v3/v4, CWEs, CAPEC attack patterns, affected open-source packages with vulnerable/fixed version ranges, linked ATT&CK techniques.
examples: Show me GHSA-jfh8-c2jp-5v3q
What does GHSA-m3wx-6f6g-9mvv affect?
Get the GitHub advisory for the log4shell vulnerability
Which CAPEC attack patterns apply to GHSA-jfh8-c2jp-5v3q?

skills.name: Package Vulnerabilities
skills.description: List vulnerabilities affecting a specific open-source package in an ecosystem (npm, pypi, go, maven, rubygems, nuget, composer, rust). Returns all GHSAs with vulnerable/fixed version ranges and linked ATT&CK techniques.
examples: Which vulnerabilities affect npm/log4js-node?
Show me GHSAs for pypi/django
Is maven/org.apache.logging.log4j:log4j-core vulnerable?
What CVEs affect the go package github.com/containerd/containerd?

skills.name: Search GitHub Security Advisories
skills.description: Search GHSA advisories by keyword, severity, ecosystem, or publication date. Returns summary, severity, affected ecosystems, linked CVEs.
examples: Show me recent CRITICAL GHSAs for npm
Search GHSA advisories about prototype pollution
List GHSA-only vulnerabilities (no CVE assigned) from the last 30 days
Show me HIGH-severity Python package vulnerabilities

skills.name: CVE to Affected Packages
skills.description: Given a CVE ID, return the open-source packages affected via its GitHub Security Advisory alias. Returns ecosystem, package name, vulnerable range, fixed version.
examples: Which packages are affected by CVE-2021-44228?
Show me the package versions vulnerable to CVE-2022-22965

skills.name: CAPEC Attack Pattern Detail
skills.description: Get a specific MITRE CAPEC attack pattern (CAPEC-N) with full taxonomy: description, abstraction (Meta/Standard/Detailed), severity, likelihood, prerequisites, skills required, resources required, consequences, example instances, linked CWEs, mapped ATT&CK techniques, mitigations, and related patterns (ChildOf/ParentOf/CanPrecede/CanFollow). 615 patterns from the CAPEC STIX 2.1 corpus.
examples: Show me CAPEC-66 SQL Injection
What are the prerequisites for CAPEC-112 Brute Force?
Which ATT&CK techniques map to CAPEC-206?
What mitigations exist for CAPEC-63 Cross-Site Scripting?

skills.name: Search CAPEC Attack Patterns
skills.description: Search/filter CAPEC attack patterns by keyword, abstraction level (Meta, Standard, Detailed), severity (Very Low..Very High), or likelihood (Low, Medium, High). Returns CAPEC ID, name, taxonomy fields, CWE references, and technique/mitigation counts.
examples: List all Very High severity CAPEC patterns
Show me CAPEC patterns about injection
Which Standard-abstraction patterns have High likelihood?
Find CAPEC patterns related to authentication bypass

https://mitre-explorer.org/a2a/data-sour: MITRE ATT&CK STIX (v18.1 — Enterprise, ICS, Mobile)
EPSS (First.org exploit-probability scoring, daily refreshed, 26,000+ scored CVEs)
CAPEC STIX 2.1 (615 attack patterns with full taxonomy: prerequisites, skills, consequences, mitigations, related patterns; also used as CWE→CAPEC→ATT&CK bridge)
MITRE Engage, RE&CT, VERIS, Azure/GCP cloud controls
